title: Strict Inclusion Under a Size Gap
statement: Let $T:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ and $n_0\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $(n_0+4)T(n_0)<2^{n_0}$. Then the class of Boolean languages recognizable by circuit-tree families of size at most $T(n)$ on inputs of length $n$ is a proper subset of the class recognizable with size at most $\max\bigl(T(n),2^{\min(n,n_0)}(\min(n,n_0)+1)+1\bigr)$ on inputs of length $n$.
